name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Movement of the Mind) — 2 Intermediate — Flight

system.description:
Telekinetic force grows strong enough to hoist a whole person from the ground, shove heavy furnishings about, or lift the thaumaturge themselves into the air.

You can move anything up to 200 pounds at a brisk walking speed, without fine control, and the object is too slow and erratic to bludgeon or cut. To seize a person, challenge your Mental Traits against their Physical Traits; you may then hoist or slowly move them, though this inflicts no damage. Most spectacularly, you may lift yourself and glide in any direction at walking speed. Flight lasts only while you concentrate to the exclusion of all else, and you must see any subject other than yourself. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
